name: VtM: Fresh Blood
source:
You are a freshly embraced Kindred of the Clan Tremere and this is your first night exploring your new abilities.

Make choices and change the outcome of the night!

[From [url=https://melcat.itch.io/vtm-fresh-blood]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是新近被接纳的瑞米尔氏族亲属，这是你探索新能力的第一个夜晚。

做出选择并改变当晚的结果！

[来自[url=https://melcat.itch.io/vtm-fresh-blood]Itch.io[/url]]
